mapper.select: /* 건강기록 대시보드 항목 조회 */ SELECT C.COM_CD , C.COM_CD_NM , CASE WHEN COALESCE(W.INDCT_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS INDCT_YN , COALESCE(W.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ) AS SORT_SEQ , CASE WHEN W.MBR_DSHBD_WDGT_SN IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS SAVED_YN FROM COM_CD C JOIN COM_CD P ON P.COM_CD_SN = C.COM_CD_PRNT_SN AND P.COM_CD = #{prntComCd} LEFT JOIN MBR_DSHBD_WDGT W ON W.DSHBD_WDGT_CD = C.COM_CD AND W.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} WHERE C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY (W.SORT_SEQ IS NULL), COALESCE(W.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ), C.SORT_SEQ
mapper.insert: /* 건강기록 대시보드 항목 저장 */ INSERT INTO MBR_DSHBD_WDGT (MBR_SN, DSHBD_WDGT_CD, INDCT_YN, SORT_SEQ) VALUES (#{mbrSn}, #{dshbdWdgtCd}, #{indctYn}, #{sortSeq}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INDCT_YN = VALUES(INDCT_YN), SORT_SEQ = VALUES(SORT_SEQ)
